title: Golden Coins Apothecary
description: A blonde woman in a green and white uniform stands behind a marble shop counter, catching floating golden coins with her right hand. The vibrant red-walled fantasy shop is filled with potion bottles, scrolls, framed paintings, purple drapes, and string lights, with an arched doorway revealing a magical night market in the background.
prompt: A dynamic fantasy scene inside a vibrant red apothecary shop with purple drapes and hanging string lights. A beautiful blonde woman in a green uniform with white accents stands behind a marble counter covered in scrolls and potion bottles, reaching out to catch floating golden coins. Shelves are filled with colorful potions and framed magical paintings. Through a large arched doorway, a glowing night market with purple banners and silhouettes is visible. Warm magical lighting, detailed digital painting style.
